title: Duplicate push notifications sent for a single mention
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in TeamChat, the user encountered: Duplicate push notifications sent for a single mention.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: @alex can you review?
2. Observe UI state: Mentioned you

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Mentioned you.

## Environment
- App: TeamChat
- Platform: web
